description: This file defines the FieldDefinitionListener class in Drupal, which reacts to CRUD operations on field definitions within the entity system, managing cache and field map updates.

classes.name: FieldDefinitionListener
classes.description: Handles reacting to creation, update, and deletion of field definitions, updating related caches and field maps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the listener with necessary services: entity type manager, entity field manager, key-value factory, and cache backend.

methods.name: onFieldDefinitionCreate
methods.description: Handles logic when a new field definition is created, updating storage, cache, and field maps.

methods.name: onFieldDefinitionUpdate
methods.description: Handles logic when a field definition is updated, notifying storage of the change.

methods.name: onFieldDefinitionDelete
methods.description: Handles logic when a field definition is deleted, updating storage, cache, and field maps accordingly.
